parameters.query:
SELECT
  pu.id::int AS "id",
  COALESCE(pu.estudiante_id, pu.docente_id)::int AS "sourceId",
  pu.tipo_usuario AS "type",
  COALESCE(e.cedula, d.cedula, pu.cedula_manual) AS "identification",
  COALESCE(e.nombres, d.nombre_docente, pu.nombres_manual) AS "fullName",
  COALESCE(e.correo, d.correo, pu.correo_manual, '') AS "institutionalEmail",
  COALESCE(vehicle_data.plates, '[]'::json) AS "vehicles",
  current_payment.payment_plan AS "paymentPlan",
  current_payment.fecha_fin::text AS "paymentValidUntil",
  CASE
    WHEN pu.estado = 'INACTIVO' THEN 'INHABILITADO'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM parqueadero_autorizaciones pa
      WHERE pa.parqueadero_usuario_id = pu.id
        AND pa.estado = 'VIGENTE'
        AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN pa.fecha_inicio AND pa.fecha_fin
    ) THEN 'HABILITADO'
    ELSE 'SIN_AUTORIZACION'
  END AS "serviceStatus",
  (pu.estado = 'ACTIVO') AS "enabled"
FROM parqueadero_usuarios pu
LEFT JOIN estudiantes e ON e.id = pu.estudiante_id
LEFT JOIN docentes d ON d.id = pu.docente_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT json_agg(UPPER(pv.placa) ORDER BY pv.es_principal DESC, pv.id) AS plates
  FROM parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  WHERE pv.parqueadero_usuario_id = pu.id AND pv.activo = TRUE
) vehicle_data ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT pm.modalidad AS payment_plan, pp.fecha_fin
  FROM parqueadero_pagos pp
  JOIN parqueadero_modalidades pm ON pm.id = pp.modalidad_id
  WHERE pp.parqueadero_usuario_id = pu.id
    AND pp.estado = 'APROBADO'
    AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN pp.fecha_inicio AND pp.fecha_fin
  ORDER BY pp.fecha_fin DESC, pp.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) current_payment ON TRUE
ORDER BY COALESCE(e.nombres, d.nombre_docente, pu.nombres_manual), pu.id;
